Searched the full category-link set embedded on the site's search page (hundreds of /jp/ja/cat/ URLs from the same global mega-nav data) for any other 'pet'-matching slug -- pet-products-pt001 was the only match; no separate/duplicate Pet Care entry point elsewhere in the nav. No pet food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found under pt001 -- both children (Cats, Dogs) are general pet-gear categories (beds, bowls, toys, storage-style pet furniture per the LURVIG line), so no MANUAL REVIEW flag needed for either open policy gap.
